notes.title: Devblog Update: Improvements and Fixes in Last Whisper!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We’re back with another update to enhance your experience in Last Whisper!

What's New?

Water in the Sky Fixed: We’ve resolved the issue with water appearing in the sky, ensuring a more immersive and realistic environment.

Improved Tree-Chopping Feedback: Chopping down trees now feels even better with added visual and auditory feedback. Gather your resources with satisfaction!

Landmine Name Fixed: 
The landmine has been renamed correctly for better clarity and consistency.
Your feedback drives our improvements, so keep sharing your thoughts! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy surviving!

Maxime L

notes.title: Last Whisper: December Update
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors,

We’re thrilled to share the latest updates for Last Whisper! Here's what's new in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/df8812f2a8b490e4b8b33cd8285c6487df672ed3.jpg[/img]

🚗 Fixed Car Driving: We’ve resolved driving mechanics to provide a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
🚗 Car Spawn Adjustments: Car spawning has been optimized for a more consistent experience when exploring.
🌊 Updated Water Mechanics: Water has been revamped to fix previous issues. It now looks and feels better than ever.
💧 Wet Effect: Characters will now display a wet effect after swimming or while in the water, adding more realism to the experience.
🎄 Christmas Tree in the Main Village: To celebrate the holidays, we’ve added a festive Christmas tree to the main village!
As always, thank you for your feedback and support. Let us know what you think of the new features, and enjoy exploring the updates!

Happy holidays,
Maxime

notes.title: Festive Update: Christmas Cheer and a New Zone in Last Whisper!
notes.content:
Season’s greetings, survivors! Maxime here, bringing you a festive update packed with holiday spirit and exciting new content for Last Whisper. Here’s what’s waiting for you:

🎅 Christmas Comes to Last Whisper
Keep an eye out for Christmas trees scattered throughout the new zone! Destroy these festive decorations to uncover special gifts filled with unique rewards like Christmas-themed decorations to bring the holiday vibe to your safe zone.

🌟 The New Zone Has Arrived!
The first part of our brand-new zone is ready for you to explore! Venture into uncharted territory, uncover its mysteries, and prepare for the challenges ahead. This is just the beginning—more expansions for this zone will come in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/a6983bfe3fee5c6e8020a801b1f13c10325db8ba.gif[/img]


🎁 Deck Your Base in Holiday Style
Unlock festive decorations to make your base feel warm and merry. From sparkling lights to snowy ornaments, you can now celebrate the holidays in true Last Whisper fashion.

This update is our way of saying thank you for being part of the incredible Last Whisper community. Your support inspires us every step of the way.

We’d love to see how you decorate your bases and what gifts you discover—don’t forget to share your festive screenshots!

Happy holidays,
Maxime and the Last Whisper Team

notes.title: Max is the game abandonned ? .. No? Why?
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

As I've mentioned before, Last Whisper is not abandoned it's simply been on the backburner while I focused on releasing my other game. 

Now that it's out, 

I can return to working on Last Whisper and continue to develop it further.

Here’s what I’ve been working on this week for Last Whisper:

[list]
[*] Updating the game with features requested by Patreon supporters.
[*] Introducing new in-game events, such as the mission board showcased in a previous update.
[*] Implementing snow and dynamic weather effects to enhance immersion.
[*] Addressing feedback from the community and fixing reported issues.
[*] Adding the final new zone to expand the world.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b]


- Maxime

notes.title: Update: Sniper Rifles & New Exploration Areas Near the Safe Zone!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We’re excited to announce an upcoming update for Last Whisper! This update introduces Sniper Rifles to the game, offering a powerful new tool for those who prefer a strategic, long-range approach to combat. With these new weapons, you’ll be able to scout out threats and take down enemies from a safe distance, adding a whole new level of depth to your gameplay.


[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43613031/6647b377bee847c7a5ca1cfdeb39651f2168f3a1.png[/img]


In addition to the new weapon, we’re also expanding the playable areas with new locations to explore near the safe zone at the beginning of the game. These areas will give you more opportunities to gather resources, discover hidden items, and face early-game challenges. Step outside the safety of the zone, and see what awaits—but remember, danger is never far away!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43613031/99aaa5c236aaac502be784d20ac46d99344147e2.jpg[/img]


Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, feel free to share your feedback on our Discord. We can’t wait to see how you use these new features in Last Whisper!

See you in the wasteland,

Maxime

notes.title: Halloween Update - Pumpkin Decorations from Yellow Hive!
notes.content:
Survivors, it’s time to embrace the spooky season in Last Whisper Survival! Our latest update brings a hauntingly festive touch to the wasteland. Here’s what’s new:

🎃 Halloween Pumpkin Decorations:

Pumpkin Drops – Now, when you take on the Yellow Hive, there’s a chance to loot Halloween pumpkin decorations! These spooky items are perfect for adding a seasonal touch to your safe zone.
Custom Placement – You have the freedom to place these pumpkins wherever you like. 

Whether it’s outside your shelter or lining the path to your base, make the wasteland your own!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43613031/714d2e6896b0592bf40dca3b0af0b7e8fcfa9c6f.png[/img]


📝 Mission Board - Coming Soon!

New Missions – Keep your eyes out for the upcoming Mission Board! Soon, you’ll be able to tackle special missions designed to challenge even the most hardened survivors.



Exclusive Rewards – Completing these missions will earn you unique rewards to aid you on your journey and enhance your base.



[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43613031/d7f7b65e5503881b49b53af5f6576bfea8c7f261.png[/img]
Get out there, scavenge those pumpkins, and prepare for the exciting new missions to come! Let us know what you think, and share your spookiest base setups!

Happy surviving and decorating!

notes.title: Dev Blog Update: Smoother Roads Ahead!
notes.content:
Hey survivors!


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43613031/9332c5ee885301c5c6f7d77c046b7e06cb7aaa0b.jpg[/img]

We’ve been listening to your feedback and noticed that some of you were having a bit of trouble navigating certain roads in Last Whisper. So, we decided to make things smoother – literally!

We’ve reworked the road system to be much easier to drive on. No more bumpy rides or tricky turns! Now you can focus more on surviving and less on struggling with the terrain.

If you have any thoughts or feedback on this update, feel free to drop them in the comments or our Discord community. We’re always looking to improve your experience!

Thanks for your continued support, and happy driving! 🚗💨2

notes.title: !!SURPRISE!! Update and Community Feedback #7
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Survivors![/h2]

I'm very happy to announce a surprise update that we believe will enhance your gameplay experience in Last Whisper Survival. We know many of you weren't expecting this, but we've been hard at work behind the scenes to bring you some essential fixes and improvements.
What's New in This Update?

[h2]    Car Speed Fix[/h2]
        We've heard your feedback regarding the vehicle speeds. Our team has made adjustments to ensure that your cars now run smoother and faster, providing you with a more enjoyable driving experience across the wasteland.

[h2]    Oven Fix[/h2]
        Previously, removing the oven from your base would result in losing the item. We've fixed this issue so that you now receive the oven back when you remove it. No more losing your hard-earned equipment!

[h2]Additional Improvements[/h2]

While these are the main highlights, we’ve also made several other small tweaks and fixes to improve the overall gameplay and address community feedback.
Community Feedback

Your feedback is invaluable to us. We encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts and suggestions on our Steam community discussions and Discord. Your input helps us shape the game and make it better with every update.

Thank you for your continuous support and enthusiasm. We hope you enjoy these new fixes and improvements. Stay tuned for more exciting updates coming your way!

Happy surviving!

Maxime

notes.title: Devblog: Experimental Branch Merge and Major Updates!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

I'm so excited to announce that the experimental branch is merging into the main game (finally), bringing a slew of enhancements, bug fixes, and new features to improve your Last Whisper Survival experience. 

[h2]Here's what you can expect in this latest update:[/h2]

[h3]New Features and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Workbench Retrieval: You can now retrieve your workbench by pressing 'Z'.
[*]     Fishing Rod: Improved durability and the ability to repair your fishing rod.
[*]     Item Highlights: Lootable items are now highlighted for easier discovery.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]     Water Bug: Fixed the notorious water bug affecting gameplay.
[*]     Mining Sound Adjustment: Adjusted mining sounds for a better audio experience.
[*]     Hive Enemy Balance: Balanced the hive enemy for a more challenging yet fair encounter.
[*]     Hive Mining Sound Fix: Fixed the issue with the hive mining sound always being at max volume.
[*]     Police Station Doors: Removed garbage blocking the doors in the police station.
[*]     Car Visibility: Fixed the bug where cars were not visible.
[*]     Car Explosion Crash: Resolved the crash caused by car explosions.
[*]     Quest Door Text: Fixed the text display issue on quest doors.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Weapon Balance: Players now start with a green (uncommon) tier 1 weapon.
[*]     Weapon Mod Prices: Adjusted the prices for weapon mods.
[*]     Repair Bench: Added more items that can be repaired on the repair bench.
[*]     Big Backpack: Increased the big backpack slots from 15 to 16.
[*]     Tree Cutting Animation: Edited the animation for tree cutting.
[*]     Food and Water from Bandages: Removed the food and water bonus from bandages.
[*]     Player Character Balance: Balanced the food and water consumption rates of the player character.
[*]     Trader Inventory: Traders now sell better weapons.
[/list]

[h3]Additional Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*]     New Car: Added a car near the safe zone for easier transportation.
[*]     AZERTY Keyboard Input: Added support for AZERTY keyboard input.
[*]     Input for 1 to 8: Mapped inputs for quick access slots 1 to 8.
[*]     Gamepad Inputs: Expanded gamepad input options for more seamless control.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Keep surviving, and we'll see you in the wasteland!

Stay safe,
Maxime

notes.title: Developer Update: Experimental Branch
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

We're excited to announce the launch of the Steam Experimental Branch for Last Whisper Survival! This special branch will allow you to test and provide feedback on upcoming builds of the game before they go live.

Why an Experimental Branch?

The purpose of the experimental branch is to involve you, our dedicated players, in the development process by giving you early access to new features, improvements, and fixes. Your feedback is crucial in helping us refine and enhance the game.
How to Access the Experimental Branch

To access the experimental branch:

    Right-click on Last Whisper Survival in your Steam library.
    Select "Properties."
    Go to the "Betas" tab.
    Select "experimental" from the dropdown menu.

Share Your Feedback

We want to hear what you love and what you don’t! After testing the updates on the experimental branch, please share your feedback with us through the survey link provided in each update. Your insights will help us make informed decisions and ensure we deliver the best possible experience.
Survey Link

A survey link will be included in all updates on the experimental branch. Please take a few moments to complete the survey and let us know your thoughts.

Thank you for your continued support and for helping us make Last Whisper Survival the best it can be!

With gratitude,

Maxime

notes.title: Devblog Demo 0.5.9 Update: Enhancements, Fixes, and Future Plans
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

We've been hard at work implementing some exciting changes and fixes to enhance your Last Whisper Survival experience. Here's a rundown of what's new in our latest demo update:

1. **Death Indicator**: Keep track of your remains with a skull icon and the distance in meters from your corpse when you perish. However, we're aware of a minor issue where the head doesn't disappear after looting the body. Rest assured, this will be rectified soon.

2. **Optimization Overhaul**: Enjoy a smoother gameplay experience with an increase of up to 30 FPS, depending on your graphics card. How did we achieve this improvement? Well, that's our little secret ;)

3. **Enhanced Security**: We've fortified our demo against potential theft, ensuring that your experience remains safe and secure.

4. **Combat Animations**: Engage in melee combat with style thanks to new animations that bring the fight to life.

5. **Tutorial Implementation**: Learn the ropes of survival with our new tutorial system. While it's simple, it's incredibly valuable for newcomers to grasp the essentials.

6. **Improved Zombie Movement**: Witness smoother and more realistic zombie movements, enhancing the overall gameplay immersion.

7. **Streamlined Loot Mechanics**: Say goodbye to building parts cluttering up your loot drops.

8. **Refined Hitboxes**: Looting just got easier with fixed hitboxes for smoother item collection.

9. **Ranged Combat Fixes**: Take down zombies from afar with improved accuracy and reliability in shooting mechanics.

10. **New Factory Environment**: Explore a new industrial setting complete with a challenging boss encounter. Dungeons have been temporarily removed until further improvements are made.

And what's on the horizon? Here's a sneak peek at what's coming next:

- **First-Person Perspective (FPP) Improvements**: Expect better animations and smoother transitions.
- **Sensitivity Options**: We're addressing your feedback by fine-tuning sensitivity settings for a more personalized experience.
- **Improved Item Mechanics**: Loot management is getting an upgrade with the option to loot all items at once.
- **Tool Combat**: Get ready to fend off threats using tools as weapons.
- **Enhanced Ladders**: Climbing will soon be a breeze with improved ladder mechanics.

We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who participated in our survey. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and polish Last Whisper Survival. Keep those ideas coming on Discord; we're always listening and eager to hear from you!

Survive. Thrive. Last Whisper.

Maxime & Viviane

notes.title: Devblog Update: Lighting and Graphics Optimizations
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, survivors of Last Whisper![/h1]

It's time for another exciting update on the development of Last Whisper Survival. We've been hard at work making some significant improvements to the game's visual quality and overall performance. In this devblog, we'll walk you through the changes we've made and give you a sneak peek at what's coming next.

[previewyoutube=tMzQFC0499Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Enhanced Environment Lighting:[/b]

One of the most noticeable changes we've made recently is the enhancement of our environment lighting system. We understand that creating a compelling and immersive atmosphere is crucial for a survival game like Last Whisper, and lighting plays a pivotal role in achieving this.

Our team has been diligently working to refine the lighting in the game, making it more dynamic, realistic, and atmospheric. The result is a world that feels even more immersive and eerie, where every shadow and beam of light contributes to the overall ambiance. Whether you're exploring a dimly lit forest or navigating the corridors of abandoned structures, you'll notice the improved lighting immediately.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/410bc118ba88ea56bfecadda682c3f97959c9a0f.png[/img]


[b]Graphic Optimizations:[/b]

Optimizing graphics is essential to ensure that Last Whisper Survival runs smoothly on a wide range of hardware configurations. We've been fine-tuning our graphics settings and implementing various optimizations to make the game more accessible to players with different hardware specifications.

Our goal is to provide an enjoyable gaming experience for as many players as possible, and these optimizations will help achieve just that. Whether you're playing on a high-end gaming rig or a more modest setup, you can expect a smoother and more visually appealing experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/e01668f05244e97ead27dcd1f0dde7b2803836ca.png[/img]



[b]Player Feedback and Survey Rewards:[/b]

At Last Whisper Survival, we value your feedback immensely. It's your input that helps us shape the game and make it even better. That's why we want to remind you about our ongoing player survey.

Your feedback in the survey is crucial to us, and as a token of our appreciation, we have exciting rewards lined up for participants. We believe in giving back to our player community for their invaluable help in making Last Whisper Survival the best it can be.

By taking a few moments to complete the survey, you not only help us understand your preferences and suggestions but also stand a chance to receive exclusive in-game rewards and gifts as a sign of our gratitude.

So, don't forget to participate in the survey when the time comes. Your voice matters, and we want to make sure you're rewarded for being an essential part of our development journey.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/238d2c066140d891661b683bcb5b102a66fb1172.png[/img]



[b]Upcoming: NVIDIA DLSS 3.5 Integration:[/b]

Now, let's talk about an exciting development on the horizon. We're thrilled to announce that we have plans to integrate NVIDIA DLSS 3.5 into Last Whisper Survival when it becomes available for Unreal Engine 5.3. NVIDIA DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) is a game-changing technology that leverages AI and machine learning to boost in-game performance while maintaining excellent image quality.

Once DLSS 3.5 becomes available for Unreal Engine 5.3, Last Whisper Survival players can look forward to significant performance improvements. DLSS will allow you to crank up your graphics settings and resolution without sacrificing frame rates, delivering an even more immersive and seamless gaming experience.


[b]NVIDIA DLSS:[/b]

We'll keep you updated on our progress with DLSS integration and provide more details as we get closer to its implementation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/c64116efc6f7dc22f93f0ee2bf98b7d37a8fafc7.png[/img]


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We're committed to making Last Whisper Survival the best it can be, and we can't wait for you to experience these enhancements in the game.



Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, stay vigilant in the world of Last Whisper!

The Last Whisper Survival Development Team

notes.title: Devlog #02: Last Whisper Survival - The struggle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/4c663dfe7bc114a73accbb1e0750fd8c2384dbf1.png[/img]



Greetings, survivors! We're thrilled to announce the latest update for Last Whisper Survival, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your survival experience. Let's dive into the details:


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172320/Last_Whisper_Survival][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/1be37164b72e09305426ef864273240b5ff2979e.png[/img][/url]



New Vehicles and Car Horns:
Get ready to explore the post-apocalyptic world in style with the addition of new 2-seater and 4-seater cars! These vehicles not only allow you to cover ground faster but also come equipped with horns, adding a new level of communication and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/9a46d21ed90d126d883c52c8896887516d74b979.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/ece4211bc641228bb764841ba028f89f6b3eef99.png[/img]

Revamped Quest System:
Now, some quests will require you to reach specific waypoints instead of collecting items, giving you more flexibility in how you approach challenges.

Expanded Item Variety:
We've added more items throughout the maps to enrich your scavenging experience. Discover new resources and tools to aid you in your quest for survival.

The Vast Desert Awaits:
Prepare for a new biome in the game – the scorching desert! Navigate the sands, face unique challenges, and seek rare resources that can only be found in this unforgiving environment.

Embrace the Coastal Life:
As you explore the world, you'll now encounter coastal areas with pristine beaches and water bodies. Watch out for potential dangers but also enjoy the serenity of these new locations.

Upgraded Weapon Arsenal:
Take your combat skills to the next level with new tiers (7) of shotgun and pistol weaponry. Gear up and make those zombies think twice before attacking you!

Zombie Effects and Behavior:
The undead have become more fearsome with this update. They now display gruesome effects such as blood splatters and losing body parts upon being hit. However, they can no longer lose their legs and right arms, making each encounter more strategic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/9325a6f773ed1ba277da989bac3362c8ea0e8762.png[/img]


Improved Camp Items:
Camps are now more diverse, with a wider array of items available for you to find and use. Build and fortify your bases with newfound resources.

Interactive Tree Hits:
Interact with the environment in a more immersive way with the new effect on hitting trees. Experience realistic reactions as you gather resources for your survival.

Enhanced Desert Roads:
Traverse the desert more efficiently with the addition of roads, making your journey through this vast landscape a bit smoother.

Flip Cars with Precision:
Utilize the 'Z' input to flip overturned cars back on their wheels. Master this skill to escape tricky situations and continue your journey without delay.

Dynamic Weather and Lighting:
Prepare for a more immersive experience as we've overhauled the weather system and lighting. Brace yourself for changing conditions that can influence your survival strategy.

New Routes to the City:
Discover new roads leading to the city, providing alternate paths to explore and loot.

Loot Overhaul:
To increase the challenge, we've balanced loot distribution. Expect more loot items inside houses and camps but a reduced number of loot opportunities in boxes and other containers.

Expanded Armor Options:
Equip yourself with the latest armor sets designed for both men and women, giving you more choices to create your unique survivalist look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43613031/68dd5d7649c2f419379a8c0c9247e9d9e701c7d5.png[/img]

We hope you're as excited as we are about this update. The team has put in countless hours to bring you these new features and improvements. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please share your thoughts on our social media platforms or the official discord.

Follow us and share your screenshots on these platforms:

Our Discord Server: [url=https://discord.gg/QDeakxU484]Discord[/url]

Survive, scavenge, and thrive in the harsh world of Last Whisper Survival! Good luck out there, survivors!
